description: Sessions 31-39 stored the Default colors, Label whitelist and Qualifier priority tables as their Web writer wrote them, before cell values were normalized. Read from such a Session, each `text` reads as `repairedText` (the current writer's rows; a comment, blank or, for Default colors, `[` line is kept, a dropped row becomes a blank line) and lists `repairs` by 1-based line. A Default colors row whose color is outside the Default colors forms (tests/fixtures/default_color_domain.json) is dropped and listed as `invalid` (OV-272); a color name reads as its hex in the Web (OV-160). Readers: gbdraw/web/js/services/file-imports.js (`legacyRows`) and gbdraw/io/table_text.py (`repair_legacy_table_text`). `valid` reads the same with and without the repair (OV-40, OV-148).
